references.text: The description of the pillars, bases, pegs, and cords of the courtyard in the tabernacle, which the Merarite Levites were responsible for carrying.
The detailed description of the construction of the courtyard, including the pillars, bases, pegs, and cords mentioned in Numbers 3:37.
Refers to the pegs of the tabernacle and the courtyard as well as the cords, which were among the items the Merarites were responsible for.
Elaborates on the Merarites' responsibility to carry the pillars, bases, pegs, and cords of the tabernacle during the journey in the wilderness.
